scenarios.title: Hidden node and inherited descendant projection
steps: Confirm the explicit hidden root and its descendant are absent from Folder Nodes projections
Enable the session reveal and inspect the explicit eye and inherited source treatment
Disable Apply hidden markers and reload without editing frontmatter
expected: Only Folder Nodes Explorer, Contents, and Graph projections hide the marked subtree
The explicit root has one status eye and the descendant shows inherited muted feedback
Session reveal resets on reload and the strict Boolean marker remains byte-preserved

scenarios.title: Preview-first migration, selection creation, and sparse ordering
steps: Preview leaf-note and missing-node migration before committing it
Create a child node from the selected fixture text after confirming the exact wikilink
Exercise before, into, and after placement using the available platform interaction
expected: No Vault write occurs before an explicit preview confirmation
Selection replacement matches the previewed wikilink exactly
Manual order uses only the parent mode and child-owned sparse rank fields
